[ASSISTANT_SAID] 5. Church music and worship resources: Worship Together, WeAreWorship.

[USER] User inquired about tips to improve their vocal range.  
[FACT] User attends choir rehearsals on Thursday evenings.  
[ASSISTANT_SAID] Assistant provided tips to improve vocal range, including:  
[ASSISTANT_SAID] 1. Warm-ups and exercises: lip trills, tongue twisters, humming exercises, arpeggios, scales, melodic patterns.  
[ASSISTANT_SAID] 2. Breathing and posture: stand or sit up straight, engage core, breathe deeply into diaphragm.  
[ASSISTANT_SAID] 3. Vocal placement: focus on placing voice in the mask of the face.  
[ASSISTANT_SAID] 4. Register transitions: practice smoothly transitioning between vocal registers.  
[ASSISTANT_SAID] 5. Record yourself singing to identify areas for improvement.  
[ASSISTANT_SAID] 6. Practice regularly and stretch your range gradually.  
[ASSISTANT_SAID] 7. Stay hydrated and rested.  
[ASSISTANT_SAID] 8. Seek guidance from a vocal coach.  
[ASSISTANT_SAID] 9. Be kind to your voice and avoid straining.  
[ASSISTANT_SAID] Assistant provided additional tips for choir rehearsals, including arriving early, listening to the director, blending voices, practicing with a metronome, and learning to read music.  
[USER] User expressed interest in exploring other faiths
